reason: B is slightly more faithful: its main translation uses お送りいたします (“send”) rather than narrowing the meaning to 発送いたします (“ship”), and 返信 more clearly refers to the sender’s own reply. Both maintain the formal apology register, though both awkwardly use 調査いたしましたところ to introduce a future action. B’s back-translation “within today” is also less natural than “today” or “by the end of today.”
